name: smwgraphics-stripeless-switch-palace
title: Stripeless Switch Palace
description:
Oh wow, words cannot express how much I despise the vanilla SMW switch palace tileset. The stripes everywhere make my eyeballs want to puke. So, I made this simplified tileset that uses the existing pallet that is a bit easier on the eyes. Could be helpful for people with photosensitivity? Can be easily recoloured to match any colour theme.

As seen in my hack Wake Up Call
